example: The rule is absolute and has no exceptions.
exampleTranslation: 这条规则是绝对的，没有例外。

example: She is writing an academic paper on language learning.
exampleTranslation: 她正在写一篇关于语言学习的学术论文。

example: The accident happened at the busy intersection.
exampleTranslation: 事故发生在繁忙的十字路口。

example: Please check your bank account before making the payment.
exampleTranslation: 付款前请检查你的银行账户。

example: They accuse him of taking the money.
exampleTranslation: 他们指责他拿了那笔钱。

example: Reading is a quiet activity that improves focus.
exampleTranslation: 阅读是一项能提高专注力的安静活动。

example: Please write your address on the envelope.
exampleTranslation: 请在信封上写下你的地址。

example: Every adult in the room agreed with the plan.
exampleTranslation: 房间里的每位成年人都同意这个计划。

example: The advertisement appeared on the front page.
exampleTranslation: 这则广告出现在头版。

example: She found the job through a local employment agency.
exampleTranslation: 她通过当地一家职业介绍机构找到了这份工作。

meaning: adj. 好斗的；有进取心的
example: The dog became aggressive when strangers approached.
exampleTranslation: 陌生人靠近时，这只狗变得有攻击性。

example: The airline cancelled the flight because of the storm.
exampleTranslation: 航空公司因暴风雨取消了航班。

example: We arrived at the airport two hours early.
exampleTranslation: 我们提前两小时到达机场。

example: The doctor advised him to stay away from alcohol.
exampleTranslation: 医生建议他远离酒精。

example: We need an alternative to the original plan.
exampleTranslation: 我们需要一个替代原计划的方案。

example: An ambulance took the injured man to hospital.
exampleTranslation: 一辆救护车把受伤的男子送到医院。

example: His ancestor came to this city many years ago.
exampleTranslation: 他的祖先很多年前来到这座城市。

example: The photo was taken from a low angle.
exampleTranslation: 这张照片是从低角度拍摄的。

example: She offered a sincere apology for the mistake.
exampleTranslation: 她为这个错误真诚地道了歉。

example: They rented a small apartment near the university.
exampleTranslation: 他们在大学附近租了一间小公寓。

example: It was apparent that he needed help.
exampleTranslation: 很明显他需要帮助。

example: The charity made an appeal for donations.
exampleTranslation: 这家慈善机构呼吁捐款。

example: Her quiet appearance hid her nervousness.
exampleTranslation: 她安静的外表掩饰了紧张。

example: The long walk gave him a good appetite.
exampleTranslation: 长途步行让他胃口很好。

example: She submitted her application before the deadline.
exampleTranslation: 她在截止日期前提交了申请。

example: I have a dental appointment at three.
exampleTranslation: 我三点有一个牙科预约。

example: Please wear appropriate clothes for the interview.
exampleTranslation: 请穿适合面试的衣服。

example: The manager will approve the request tomorrow.
exampleTranslation: 经理明天会批准这个请求。

example: The architect designed a bright, open library.
exampleTranslation: 这位建筑师设计了一座明亮开阔的图书馆。

example: Their argument was about money, not work.
exampleTranslation: 他们的争论是关于钱，而不是工作。

example: The police will arrest the suspect tonight.
exampleTranslation: 警方今晚将逮捕嫌疑人。

example: The arrival of the train was delayed by snow.
exampleTranslation: 火车因雪晚点到达。

example: The park has an artificial lake in the center.
exampleTranslation: 公园中央有一个人工湖。

example: The artist painted the wall with bright colors.
exampleTranslation: 这位艺术家用明亮的颜色粉刷了墙壁。

example: Teachers assess students through tests and projects.
exampleTranslation: 老师通过测试和项目评估学生。

example: The assignment is due at the end of the week.
exampleTranslation: 这项作业周末截止。

example: Volunteers assist visitors at the information desk.
exampleTranslation: 志愿者在咨询台帮助参观者。

example: The young athlete trains six days a week.
exampleTranslation: 这位年轻运动员每周训练六天。

example: The restaurant has a warm and friendly atmosphere.
exampleTranslation: 这家餐厅气氛温暖友好。

example: Please pay attention to the safety instructions.
exampleTranslation: 请注意安全说明。

example: The audience clapped loudly after the performance.
exampleTranslation: 演出结束后观众热烈鼓掌。

example: The author will sign books at the library.
exampleTranslation: 作者将在图书馆签售书籍。

example: The local authority plans to open a new park.
exampleTranslation: 当地政府计划开放一个新公园。

example: The doors are automatic and open when you get close.
exampleTranslation: 这些门是自动的，靠近时就会打开。

example: The leaves turn yellow in autumn.
exampleTranslation: 秋天树叶变黄。

example: She received an award for her research.
exampleTranslation: 她因研究获得了一个奖项。

example: The mountains form a beautiful background in the photo.
exampleTranslation: 群山在照片中构成美丽的背景。

example: The battery in my phone is almost dead.
exampleTranslation: 我手机的电池快没电了。

example: Good behavior in class helps everyone learn.
exampleTranslation: 课堂上的良好行为有助于每个人学习。

example: She has a strong belief in the value of hard work.
exampleTranslation: 她坚信努力的价值。
